model_card.data: QC Synthetic Data: 2,200 synthetic casting-defect images, 22 classes

binary.note: Trained for 1 epoch. The 'no defect' class was 178 low-texture corner crops taken from the defect images themselves, not real defect-free jewellery.

classes.name: Gas Porosity
classes.description: Small, round, smooth-walled voids left by gas trapped in the metal as it solidified.

classes.name: Shrinkage Porosity
classes.description: Irregular, rough-edged voids where the metal contracted while freezing, typically in thicker sections.

classes.name: Pinholes
classes.description: Very small, pin-sized holes at or just under the surface, often from escaping gas.

classes.name: Blisters
classes.description: Raised bubbles or bumps on the surface where gas was trapped beneath it.

classes.name: Carbon / Black Spots
classes.description: Dark spots or patches, commonly from carbon residue left by incomplete burnout of wax or investment.

classes.name: Cold Shut
classes.description: A seam or line where two metal streams met but did not fully fuse.

classes.name: Cracks
classes.description: Linear fractures in the metal, often from stress or too-rapid cooling.

classes.name: Dimensional Shrinkage
classes.description: The piece comes out smaller or out of shape relative to the intended dimensions because of contraction.

classes.name: Firescale / Oxidation
classes.description: Grey, purple or dark discolouration of the surface caused by oxidation during heating.

classes.name: Flash / Fins
classes.description: Thin sheets or ridges of excess metal along seams, where metal leaked into cracks in the mould.

classes.name: Heavy Porosity
classes.description: Widespread, dense porosity across a large part of the surface or section.

classes.name: Hot Tears
classes.description: Ragged cracks that form while the metal is still cooling and weak, usually at stress points.

classes.name: Investment Inclusions
classes.description: Particles of mould (investment) material embedded in or stuck to the metal surface.

classes.name: Misrun / Short Fill
classes.description: Incomplete casting where the metal failed to fill part of the mould cavity.

classes.name: Nodule
classes.description: Small rounded lumps or bumps standing proud of the surface.

classes.name: Orange Peel / Spongy
classes.description: A dimpled, orange-peel or sponge-like rough surface texture.

classes.name: Pits
classes.description: Small depressions or craters in the surface.

classes.name: Sink Marks
classes.description: Shallow surface depressions caused by localised shrinkage over thicker sections.

classes.name: Warp / Distortion
classes.description: The piece is bent, twisted or otherwise deformed from its intended shape.

classes.name: Water Streak Marks
classes.description: Streaky lines or marks left where water, steam or quenching contacted the surface.

classes.name: Metal Beads
classes.description: Small spherical droplets of metal stuck to or near the piece.

classes.name: Slag Inclusions
classes.description: Non-metallic slag or dross particles trapped in the metal.
